title: 印度豪掷200亿美元：押注AI芯片与制造，能否复制中国奇迹？
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: Indian Prime Minister Narendra Modi is laying out a sweeping vision worth nearly 20 billion dollars to boost semiconductor and smartphone manufacturing as he looks to position the
segments.zh: 印度总理莫迪正提出一项近200亿美元的宏大计划，以推动半导体和智能手机制造业发展，旨在让印度抓住全球AI热潮的机遇。

segments.en: country to take advantage of a global AI boom.
segments.zh: 政府最新方案包括约130亿美元用于芯片，近70亿美元用于智能手机和电子产品。

segments.en: The government's latest package includes roughly $13 billion for chips and almost 7 billion for smartphones and electronics.
segments.zh: 该计划基于印度2021年启动的100亿美元芯片项目，该项目吸引了美光等公司的**。

segments.en: It builds on India's original $10 billion chip program launched in 2021 which drew investments from companies including micron and tarar group.
segments.zh: 新激励措施覆盖芯片设计、设备制造到研发等多个领域。

segments.en: The new incentives target areas from chip design and equipment fabrication to research and development.
segments.zh: 硅谷巨头也在印度大规模投入。

segments.en: Silicon Valley has its own massive commitments in the country.
segments.zh: 亚马逊近期追加130亿美元用于AI和云基础设施。

segments.en: Amazon recently added another $13 billion for AI and cloud infrastructure.
segments.zh: 微软承诺四年内投入175亿美元。

segments.en: Microsoft has pledged 17.5 billion over four years.
segments.zh: Almeta与信实工业合作，建设其在印度的首个AI数据中心。

segments.en: Almeta is partnering with reliance industries on its first AI-focused India data center.
segments.zh: 本土巨头也在加大押注。穆克什·安巴尼的信实集团表示，可能投入高达1100亿美元用于AI相关基础设施。

segments.en: Local champions are betting even bigger. Mukesh Ambani's reliance says it could invest as much as $110 billion in AI-related infrastructure
segments.zh: 本土巨头更是大手笔押注。穆克什·安巴尼的信实集团表示，可能投入高达1100亿美元用于AI相关基础设施。

segments.en: over seven years. And the Adani group is committing $100 billion to build data centers powered by renewable energy.
segments.zh: 七年多来，阿达尼集团承诺投入1000亿美元建设由可再生能源供电的数据中心。

segments.en: Still, India's commitment remains smaller than the semiconductor watches assembled by China and the United States.
segments.zh: 尽管如此，印度的投入仍小于中国和美国组装的半导体监视器。
